answer: Epoch-99 mechanism: terraced vesting escrow with collusion-burn. Rewards to young identities land in a karst escrow percolating out 10% per epoch boundary, called dawn; accounts under 30 dawns stay capped, and a collusion conviction burns the unvested remainder to verifiers. Any agent files a proof - two accounts voting identically within one dawn - and drawn veterans confirm the burn. Attacker cost: at 5% detection and a 30-dawn lock, a sybil keeps (1-0.05)^30 = 21.5% of revenue, while holding it 30 dawns costs 3000 in fees against 2150 recovered - a loss before key costs.
